item.title: FTSE 100 dips as Middle East talks rumble on
item.summary: The FTSE 100 slipped on Monday as oil prices ticked higher amid reports that Middle East talks were progressing, but not at the pace many would like to see Brent crude rose 1% to $84.10 on reports that Iran and Oman were nearing a deal requiring engagement with the US, which didn’t appear forthcoming.
